message.reasoning_content: Key suspicion: butterfly computes natural-order Hadamard, then reordering via gray code. The standard sequency order needs bit-reversal plus Gray-code permutation. The kernel's permutation: gray = lane ^ (lane>>1); source_lane = bit-reverse of gray. Standard fast WHT to sequency: reverse input bits, then gray... Let me just test empirically. Record claim and probe.
